atalk_enabled.description: Enable AppleTalk support globally. Set to true to start atalkd with active configuration.

atalk_device.description: Network interface (e.g., eth0, enp3s0) to bind AppleTalk protocol to.

atalk_addr_start.description: First AppleTalk network number (in A.B format) for this segment.

atalk_addr_end.description: Last AppleTalk network number (in A.B format) for this segment — use same as start for single-network zones.

default_zone.description: Default AppleTalk zone name assigned to untagged traffic on this network.

nbp_enabled.description: Enable Name Binding Protocol (NBP) — required for name lookup (e.g., printer services).

rtmp_enabled.description: Enable RTMP routing between AppleTalk networks. Only needed if routing beyond a single segment.

zones.description: Explicitly define zones (AppleTalk address groups). Each zone has a name and optional list of network ranges.

ranges.description: List of AppleTalk network ranges belonging to this zone.

router_interfaces.description: Interfaces that act as AppleTalk routers between zones. Required only for multi-zone routing.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous AppleTalk connections (e.g., from Mac clients).

ddp_checksum.description: Enable strict DDP (Datagram Delivery Protocol) checksum verification. Disable only for legacy hardware that omits checksums.

log_level.description: Verbose logging level (0 = silent, 7 = debug). Recommended: 1–3 for production.
